channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about Bryn Forbes | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about Bryn Forbes from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: Gregg Popovich on Bryn Forbes
item.description:
Tom Orsborn:Pop on Bryn Forbes:

“He’s just having a tough time getting a rhythm, finding his game. He knows the program very well.”

Gregg Popovich on Bryn Forbes, Nov 24, 2021. Source: Twitter @tom_orsborn.

item.title: Gregg Popovich on Derrick White, DeMar DeRozan, Bryn Forbes
item.description:
Tom Orsborn:Pop on White's return making life easier for DeRozan and Forbes:

“They are not point guards. And Derrick has assumed that position since we brought him to the Spurs,and he has developed real well. Hopefully, he will continue that process.”

Gregg Popovich on Derrick White, DeMar DeRozan, Bryn Forbes, Nov 12, 2018. Source: Twitter @tom_orsborn.

item.title: Patty Mills on Bryn Forbes
item.description:
Mills on Forbes:

“I think he’s done a hell of a job given the circumstances. He is a great outlet. Just him being on the floor, people are starting to sniff out of how lethal a shooter he is and playing him honestly, which opens up the floor for LaMarcus and DeMar.”

Patty Mills on Bryn Forbes, Oct 27, 2018. Source: Twitter @tom_orsborn.
